subject.title: [Feature]:Add configUrl and configButton support in SKILL.md frontmatter

question: Should OpenClaw expose skill-authored configuration actions from `SKILL.md` frontmatter, and what URL/action trust contract should the dashboard enforce?
rationale: The implementation path is bounded, but accepting arbitrary skill-provided configuration URLs changes public skill metadata and dashboard trust semantics.

options.title: Approve typed config action
options.body: Add a generic skill configuration action with explicit URL validation, trust labeling, default label behavior, API/docs coverage, and dashboard rendering.

options.title: Use existing link surfaces
options.body: Keep `homepage`, Skill Cards, ClawHub pages, and plugin UI descriptors as the supported discovery paths until a clearer settings surface is needed.

options.title: Prototype through ClawHub first
options.body: Let ClawHub or Skill Card metadata carry configuration links first, then add a dashboard action only after the trust model is proven.

recommendation.title: Approve typed config action
recommendation.body: Add a generic skill configuration action with explicit URL validation, trust labeling, default label behavior, API/docs coverage, and dashboard rendering.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses Skills page rendering and skills metadata/status surfaces that recent history routes through shakkernerd.
